skillsData.title: Linear Regression & Regularization
skillsData.desc: OLS closed-form solution (XᵀX)⁻¹Xᵀy vs Gradient Descent. Ridge (L2), Lasso (L1) feature selection, ElasticNet. Assumptions: Linearity, independence, homoscedasticity, residual normality, VIF multicollinearity.
skillsData.formula: Loss = ||y - Xw||² + λ₁||w||₁ + λ₂||w||₂²
questions: Why does L1 regularization cause sparse weights while L2 only shrinks them?
What happens to the OLS solution when features are perfectly collinear?
How do you detect and treat heteroscedasticity in residual plots?

skillsData.title: Logistic Regression & BCE Loss
skillsData.desc: Sigmoid activation mapping linear combinations to probabilities. Derivation of Log-Loss / Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) using Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE). One-vs-Rest & Softmax extensions.
skillsData.formula: BCE = -1/N ∑ [y_i log(p_i) + (1-y_i) log(1-p_i)]
questions: Derive the gradient update rule for Logistic Regression using MLE.
Why can't linear regression with squared loss be used directly for classification?
How do odds ratios (e^β) interpret feature changes?

skillsData.title: Decision Trees & Random Forests
skillsData.desc: Splitting criteria (Gini impurity, Entropy, Information Gain). Bagging to reduce variance. Sub-sampling sqrt(p) features per split. Out-of-Bag (OOB) error estimation & MDI vs Permutation importance.
skillsData.formula: Gini = 1 - ∑ (p_i)², Entropy = - ∑ p_i log₂(p_i)
questions: Why does feature randomness in Random Forests decrease correlation between trees?
How does Permutation Feature Importance differ from Mean Decrease in Impurity (MDI)?
How do tree depth and min_samples_split prevent overfitting?

skillsData.title: Gradient Boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost)
skillsData.desc: Sequential boosting fitting pseudo-residuals. XGBoost second-order Taylor expansion, gain calculation, weight regularization (γ, λ). LightGBM leaf-wise growth (GOSS, EFB). CatBoost ordered target encoding.
skillsData.formula: Obj = ∑ L(y_i, ŷ_i^(t-1) + f_t(x_i)) + Ω(f_t)
questions: Explain the second-order Taylor expansion used in XGBoost's objective function.
Compare leaf-wise tree growth (LightGBM) vs depth-wise growth (XGBoost standard).

skillsData.title: Feedforward Neural Networks & Backprop

How do He (Kaiming) and Xavier initialization prevent gradient explosion/vanishing?

skillsData.title: Transformers & Attention Mechanisms
skillsData.desc: Scaled Dot-Product Attention & Multi-Head Self-Attention formulation (Q, K, V). Absolute vs Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE). Encoder-only (BERT), Decoder-only (GPT), and Encoder-Decoder (T5) paradigms.
skillsData.formula: Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax( (Q Kᵀ) / √d_k ) V

How does RoPE embed relative position information directly into Query/Key rotation?

skillsData.title: PEFT: LoRA & QLoRA Fine-Tuning
skillsData.desc: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) decomposing weight updates ΔW = B × A with rank r << d. QLoRA using 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4), Double Quantization, and Paged Optimizers.
skillsData.formula: W_updated = W_frozen + (α / r) * (B × A),  where B ∈ R^(d×r), A ∈ R^(r×k)

What is NF4 in QLoRA and why is it information-theoretically optimal for zero-mean normal weights?
When should you adapt query/value matrices vs all linear layers in an LLM?

skillsData.title: LLM Alignment: RLHF, DPO & KTO

skillsData.formula: L_DPO = -E [ log σ( β log(π_θ(y_w|x)/π_ref(y_w|x)) - β log(π_θ(y_l|x)/π_ref(y_l|x)) ) ]

skillsData.title: Model Quantization & Inference Kernels
